name: Komeya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood rice shop (Minori Kometen): a closing-day change notice, a first day working part-time, a delivery-service guide, an online-ordering start notice, a first-time-customer usage guide, a lesson in rephrasing a milling-percentage number as a taste description, teaching a junior how to check rice freshness, the shop's history of introducing a milling-records app, a rice subscription plan guide, a tasting-event subscription trend column, a hybrid freshness-check membership system guide, a reflection on balancing efficiency and taste, and a one-year report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
